scene: The badger wakes, yawns politely, and reveals a colorful transport hub.
picture: Flat side-view across green turf. On the far left sits a low wooden dock with a glass-bottomed rowboat. The lanky boy in his orange puffer vest stands left of centre beside the awake badger. Up high swings a yellow chairlift seat, while on the far right idles a brass sleigh tram.
shown: a glass-bottomed rowboat bobbing at a low wooden dock on the far left
a swinging double chairlift seat hanging from an iron pylon up high
a brass sleigh tram with frosted runners idling on the far right
